THIRD-PARTY LICENSES: website 3D player bundle
==============================================

`twisty.js` in this directory is a prebuilt, minified bundle that draws the home page's 3D cube.
It is built from pinned versions by tools/website (npm run build), which is where its source comes from.

1. cubing.js 0.66.1 (the `cubing` package), https://github.com/cubing/cubing.js
   Licensed "MPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later"; used here under GPL-3.0-or-later, the license of this
   project (see LICENSE.txt at the repository root). Copyright (c) the cubing.js authors.

2. three.js (bundled by cubing.js), https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
